source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Run CPU stress tool (EX: AMD_Validation_Toolkit) to heat system
2. Set the all system fans speed to low. And check if CPU thermal to high, system should be shutdown, BMC SEL have log about thermal trip
3. Power off system and recover fan controller.
4. Power on system and check if system work as normal. ( Ex: cd to file folder, cp files, network ... )
6. AC cycle system and check if system work as normal

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. System should shutdown when CPU temperature arrive Thermal Trip
2. BMC SEL should have log about Thermal Trip
3. System should power off without problem
4. System should power on without problem
5. System should work without problem after AC cycle
note: CPU caution1: 95/caution2: 97 /caution3: 99  dgree C

original_test_intent: Drive the CPU to the platform thermal-trip condition using an approved workload and low-fan profile, verify protective shutdown and SEL reporting, then restore cooling and prove power, AC-cycle and functional recovery.
original_method: A validated automated thermal controller runs the approved CPU diagnostic, lowers all fans under hard safety limits, observes the trip shutdown and SEL, restores the fan controller in the power-off state, boots, cycles AC by the approved project method and runs basic functionality checks.
manual_activity: No physical heating, heatsink removal or visual acceptance appears in the source. Human input is approval and exceptional recovery availability, not a normal core operation.
required_inputs: CPU/platform identity, true trip point and interpretation of 95/97/99 C cautions
Approved AMD validation/stress workload and duration
BMC fan-low/restore mappings, sensor sources and SEL event identity
Abort ceiling below damage, shutdown detection and finally-style cooling recovery
Approved power-on/AC-cycle/recovery plan and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Do not remove a heatsink or apply external/uncontrolled heat; those are not source steps.
Continuously monitor independent temperature, fan and OOB health and abort at the approved ceiling or on sensor loss.
Guarantee fan restoration even after shutdown/tool failure and verify RPM/profile before recovery.
Stop on first unexpected trip, BMC loss or failed restoration; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, run the validated workload/fan sequence, capture trip/SEL/shutdown evidence and enforce aborts.
Restore cooling, execute approved power/AC recovery and run file/network/host checks.
Report raw behavior and recovery separately from the engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve trip/caution semantics, workload, fan and power recovery plan.
Provide exceptional physical recovery only if the safe automated path stops.
Review evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its human-only/heatsink-removal assertion is not source-faithful and must not be used.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Review and use the named repository OOB script with validated platform workload, fan and power controls; do not invent physical heating.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: CPU workload, all-fan-low trip, shutdown/SEL, fan restoration, power/AC recovery, 95/97/99 C note and 20/60-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: QUALIFY EXISTING OOB SCRIPT; PROHIBIT UNCONTROLLED PHYSICAL HEATING
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use redundant sensor/OOB monitoring, hard pre-trip abort rules where the owner procedure allows, definitive shutdown/SEL correlation and guaranteed verified fan restoration before boot and AC recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact CPU, board, BMC and cooling implementation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record CPU microcode, BIOS, BMC/CPLD, workload and script versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner CPU/platform thermal-trip and fan-control specifications plus repository script revision.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds safe orchestration and disallows a historical method the source never requested.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; the actual software/fan-induced protective trip remains required.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Trip/caution semantics, workload, controls, sensors and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A thermal trip intentionally removes host access, so evidence and recovery control must remain external.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a non-destructive simulated event only as different coverage; it cannot claim the source real thermal-trip shutdown. AC mechanism may be project-selected unless physical removal is explicitly required by that plan.
expected_evidence: Approved CPU/BMC identity, trip/caution limits, workload, fan controls, abort/recovery and authorization
Time-aligned temperature/fan/power telemetry, workload output and trip shutdown timing
BMC SEL thermal-trip event plus external console/OOB evidence
Verified fan restoration, boot/AC-cycle recovery, functional checks and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently describes software stress and fan reduction. Its caution values need definition but do not conflict with the trip expectation; heatsink removal exists only in DeepSeek.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Platform-specific controls are readiness inputs. The source defines a coherent controlled path and does not require guessing an unsafe physical action.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Reject the unsupported physical method and NO classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain its controlled path and safety controls; classify FULLY AUTOMATABLE under V3.1 because normal core actions are machine-controllable.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates severe risk and readiness from capability while preserving the actual source method.

review_improvement: Removes an unsafe invented heatsink operation and replaces it with source-faithful, externally monitored thermal-trip orchestration and recovery proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source explicitly supplies a software workload and all-fan-low stimulus. On a platform with validated controls, these, shutdown detection, SEL collection and recovery are automatable; the need for approval does not make the case partial or manual.
